name: AC Fatura – e-Arşiv Fatura Entegrasyonu for WooCommerce
author: alpercengiz

sections.description:
Bir WooCommerce siparişini saniyeler içinde faturalayın: alıcı, ürünler, kargo ve KDV siparişten gelir, GİB’in gönderdiği SMS koduyla onaylarsınız, müşteriniz PDF’i e-postayla alır. Her pakette bütün özellikler.

AC Fatura issues the e-Arşiv invoices of your WooCommerce orders through your own account on the GİB e-Arşiv Portal (the Turkish Revenue Administration’s free invoicing portal), in your name. No private integrator sits in between and you do not buy credits (“kontör”). The invoice is created at GİB and also appears in your portal.

The plugin’s screens are in Turkish, because it serves sellers who invoice under Turkish tax rules.

How it works

  1. You enter your GİB e-Arşiv Portal user code and password once.
  2. When an order is completed (or paid, if you prefer), its invoice is queued for signing. Buyer, line items, shipping and VAT are filled in from the order.
  3. You preview the invoice and sign it with the SMS code GİB sends to your phone. Several invoices can be signed together with a single code.
  4. The invoice issued by GİB is e-mailed to your customer with the PDF attached.

Features

  • No integrator contract and no credits; you use your own GİB account
  • Invoice preview, with a warning when it does not match the order total
  • Bulk signing with a single SMS code (up to 20 invoices at a time)
  • Invoice e-mail to the customer with the PDF attached; logo, colour, design and text are yours
  • Cancellation requests, and downloads of GİB’s official invoice file (ZIP) and its PDF
  • Online-sale details (payment method, carrier and its tax number, dispatch date) written into the invoice note
  • VAT rate per line item; the Central Bank (TCMB) exchange rate for orders in a foreign currency
  • An invoice status column in the WooCommerce order list
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

Who is it for?

Sellers who use the GİB e-Arşiv Portal. This plugin does not issue e-Fatura; taxpayers registered for e-Fatura cannot issue e-Arşiv invoices from the portal.

Every signature needs GİB’s SMS code, so invoices are not issued fully automatically. Tax decisions such as 0% VAT or “no invoice needed” are the seller’s.

Pricing

The plugin is free and all features are available on every plan. The plans of the AC Fatura service differ only in the number of invoices per month (prices include VAT):

  • Free: up to 10 invoices a month
  • Standart 100: up to 100 invoices a month, 399 TL / month
  • Standart 1000: up to 1,000 invoices a month, 599 TL / month
  • Standart 1000+: up to 2,000 invoices a month, 999 TL / month

There is no charge per invoice.

External services

This plugin relies on the AC Fatura service, an external API at https://api.faturaservisi.com, to issue e-Arşiv invoices at the Turkish Revenue Administration (GİB). The service is provided by Alper Cengiz (AC Studio), Berlin, Germany, the author of this plugin; its servers are in the European Union. The plugin does not work without the service. Installing the plugin sends no data by itself: data is sent only after an administrator ticks the consent box on the plugin’s first screen and presses “Onayla ve bağlan” (Agree and connect).

What is sent to the service, and when:

  • When connecting the site: your site address and the administrator e-mail address. To verify that the request really comes from your site, the service reads the ac-fatura/v1/verify route of your site’s REST API once.
  • When connecting the GİB account: your GİB e-Arşiv Portal user code and password. The service stores them encrypted so that it can issue invoices at GİB in your name. They are not stored in the WordPress database. “Bağlantıyı kaldır” (Remove connection) in the settings deletes the password from the service.
  • When previewing, issuing or e-mailing an invoice: that order’s number and date, the buyer’s name, address, phone and e-mail address, the national ID / tax number if present, line items, amounts, payment and shipping details. The service passes these on to GİB and does not store them; it keeps only the order number, the invoice number and its status.
  • When an order is completed or paid: only the order number (to queue it for signing).
  • When buying a plan: the details for the invoice we issue to you (name/title, tax number, address, e-mail).
  • When submitting the help form: your message and your reply address.

To issue the invoice, the service connects with your account to the GİB e-Arşiv Portal (earsivportal.efatura.gov.tr; Revenue Administration of the Republic of Türkiye) and sends the invoice e-mail through Resend (resend.com). For orders in a foreign currency the exchange rate is read from the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (tcmb.gov.tr).

  • Service: Terms of use · Privacy policy · Data processing agreement
  • GİB: e-Arşiv Portal · gib.gov.tr
  • Resend: Terms · Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce is required).
  2. Open WooCommerce → AC Fatura, agree to the data transfer and press “Onayla ve bağlan”.
  3. On the Ayarlar (Settings) tab enter your GİB user code and password, verify the signing phone and define your carrier.
  4. Invoice your orders from the Faturalar (Invoices) tab.

Your site must be reachable from the internet and its REST API must not be disabled.
sections.faq:
Does it issue e-Fatura?

No. It only issues e-Arşiv invoices through the GİB e-Arşiv Portal.

Do I need credits or an integrator contract?

No. Invoices are issued from your own GİB e-Arşiv Portal account.

Are invoices issued automatically?

The order is queued for signing automatically; to sign, you enter GİB’s SMS code. Several invoices can be signed with one code.

Does it ask the customer for a national ID number?

No, it adds no field to your checkout. If a valid number saved by a billing-field plugin is on the order it is used; otherwise the final-consumer number (11111111111) is written.

Where is my GİB password kept?

At the AC Fatura service, encrypted. It is not stored in WordPress and is never shown on any screen.

Is customer data stored?

No. Order details are sent to the service while an invoice is being issued and are not stored; the service keeps only the order number, the invoice number and its status.

How do I pay?

Choose a plan on the Paket (Plan) tab; the bank transfer details and a reference code of your own are shown. When you press “Ödemeyi yaptım” (I have paid) the plan opens provisionally at once and becomes permanent when your payment has been checked.
